Display an evolution_management object. If id is provided, show that object;
otherwise list

evolution_management and show the first.



Respects field-level read permissions (BLI-642). Output format via --format.

  Show first evolution management
  zqk object evoman show
  Show by ID
  zqk object evoman show EVOL-001
  Show in JSON format
  zqk object evoman show --format json

Usage:
  zqk object evoman show [flags]

Global Flags:
      --allow-degraded   Allow scheduler-dependent commands to run when scheduler daemon is not running
      --internal         Elevated access mode for built-in and internal kinds (requires Enterprise license or zqk-admin)
